name: external_vitalsense_beat_ibi_benchmark_preflight_v1
scope: adapter and single-record smoke test only

reference.primary: ECG Lead II R-peak timestamps from the reference stream
reference.alignment: use recorded timestamps if supplied; otherwise map native sample indices to seconds. A session lag may be estimated only from an independent synchronization channel such as RSP, frozen before beat evaluation.
reference.vitalsense2024_smoke_test: same-ADC index correspondence, fixed lag 0 s, no ECG-driven lag optimization

radar_route: raw FMCW chirps -> target-bin phase/unwrapping -> displacement vital signal
0.3 Hz low-pass respiratory estimate; cardiac residual = vital minus respiratory
period proposal via spectrum/autocorrelation; pulse template from radar residual; reverse-template adaptive matched filter; peak timestamps
store every processing parameter and output one timestamp vector per session

beat_matching.matching: chronological one-to-one greedy matching after fixed alignment
exclude: reference artifacts/ectopic beats only when a predeclared ECG QC rule marks them

metrics.HR_absolute_error_bpm: absolute difference of 60 / median IBI, computed independently for all accepted reference and radar beats in a session
metrics.matched_IBI_MAE_ms: mean absolute difference of adjacent intervals from consecutive one-to-one matched beat pairs
metrics.beat_recall: matched reference beats / eligible reference beats
metrics.beat_precision: matched radar beats / eligible radar beats
metrics.RMSSD_error_ms: absolute difference in RMSSD of matched IBI sequences
metrics.SDNN_error_ms: absolute difference in SDNN of matched IBI sequences

split_rule: subject-disjoint: all sessions/scenarios of a subject occur in exactly one split. Tune thresholds/template choices only on training subjects; report held-out subjects, with no random window split.

shared: 3 ms frame route when source metadata confirms it
not_comparable_without_reimplementation: baseline's exact manual peak prominence/filter tuning
publication figures or any unexported annotation policy
